title: Sacred Groves of Western Ghats: Biodiversity & Vedic Rituals
subtitle: Devarakadus and sacred forests protected by community taboos for two millennia
short_description: Ecological study of sacred forest patches conserved by local communities.
body:
Sacred Groves of Western Ghats

Across Kodagu and Kerala, the Devarakadus serve as living gene banks for endangered medicinal plants and freshwater springs.
